svg.title: How IBM discovers, governs and secures AI
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Discover: discover both known and unknown AI assets and agents, and keep a centralized AI inventory. Enforce: automate policy enforcement, obligation mapping and compliance evidence capture, continuously. Detect: detect malicious input prompts and block sensitive data from being sent to your models.
